description: Standalone Morphe patches for Gboard Rambler: exhaustive native Rambler voice typing settings page with Hex by Anomaly Listening & Processing waveforms, Custom Instructions, Personal Dictionary (MUSE_STATS + Use dictionary words toggle), Contact Names, Cursor-Aware & Append-Only Editing, and App Context. Designed to work alongside upstream GboardWu. Verified on Gboard 18.5.4; newer versions are unverified.
